mapper.select: select coalesce(max(version), 0) + 1 from xfc_2026_pdf_file where registration_id=#{registrationId}
mapper.insert: insert into xfc_2026_pdf_file (registration_id, version, file_path, generated_at) values (#{registrationId}, #{version}, #{filePath}, now())
mapper.select: select p.id, p.registration_id as registrationId, p.version, p.file_path as filePath, p.generated_at as generatedAt from xfc_2026_pdf_file p inner join xfc_2026_registration r on r.id=p.registration_id where p.id=#{id} and r.captain_user_id=#{captainUserId}
